description: 立式轴承座（底座+圆柱座孔+安装孔）
description_en: A pillow block bearing housing with base and mounting holes
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
bore_d = 40        # 轴承孔径 (mm)
outer_d = 80       # 座圈外径 (mm)
cap_h = 50         # 座圈高度 (mm) (从底座顶面)
base_w = 140       # 底座宽度 (mm)
base_d = 60        # 底座深度 (mm)
base_h = 20        # 底座高度 (mm)
bolt_d = 12        # 安装螺栓孔径 (mm)
bolt_spacing = 110 # 螺栓孔间距 (mm)
oil_hole_d = 6     # 油孔直径 (mm)

# === 底座 ===
base = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(base_w, base_d, base_h)
)

# 安装螺栓孔
base = (
    base
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .pushPoints([(-bolt_spacing / 2, 0), (bolt_spacing / 2, 0)])
    .hole(bolt_d)
)

# === 轴承座圈 (半圆柱) ===
seat = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=base_h / 2)
    .circle(outer_d / 2)
    .extrude(cap_h)
)
result = base.union(seat)

# 轴承孔 (贯通)
result = (
    result
    .faces(">Y").workplane()
    .center(0, cap_h / 2 + base_h / 2)
    .hole(bore_d, base_d + 10)
)

# === 油孔 (顶部) ===
result = (
    result
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(oil_hole_d, cap_h / 2)
)

# === 圆角 ===
result = result.edges("|Z").fillet(3)

show_object(result)
